title: Rav Achdevoi bar Rav Mattenah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Bava Batra 151a relates that the sister of Rav Tuvia bar Rav Matna wrote her property over to him in the morning, and in the evening wrote it over to Rav Achdevoi bar Rav Mattenah; he came before Rav Nachman. In Shabbat 60b we find: “Rav Matnei said — and some say Rav Achdevoi bar [Rav, Dikdukei Soferim] Matna said that Rav Matna said.” So it is in Shabbat 24a according to Dikdukei Soferim.

notes.text: The exact Dikdukei Soferim readings and the Shabbat 24a edition claim remain attributed to Hyman; the consulted Shabbat 60b passage supplies the alternative transmitter chain.
